actors.name: Principal
actors.private_context: The principal is responsible for approving school trips. They are aware that the geography department's coastal field trip has run without incident for four years. They know the deputy head is on leave until late September, and that the risk-assessment form now requires the deputy head's signature. The principal may have concerns about the new coach operator and the missing signature.

actors.name: Geography Department Head
actors.private_context: The geography department head has prepared the proposal for the coastal field trip, including a risk assessment. They know the new coach operator and that the risk-assessment form needs an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. They want the principal to sign off before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters.

shared_context: Petersfield Secondary School has a half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters for the coastal field trip. The trip has run without incident for four years. This year, there is a new coach operator and the risk-assessment form requires an additional signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The geography department head can submit the proposal to the principal for approval.

starting_events.description: The geography department head submits the coastal field trip proposal and risk assessment to the principal for sign-off.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the principal signed off on the geography department's proposed coastal field trip before 2026-10-16T15:30:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
